description: Type the 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION create/patch return when a starting URL uses an IP address that is not reserved as a static address in the project ("... has an IP address that is not  reserved as static for this project"). Right after an address is reserved this is eventual consistency; it surfaced as a generic BadRequest.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A starting URL's IP address is not reserved as a static address in this project (HTTP 400 FAILED_PRECONDITION). Reserve it first; retry briefly right after reserving.

message.includes: reserved as static for this project
